descFull: A background virtual screen on your Android phone for any AI agent, on the phone, a computer or the cloud: it operates apps on a separate display while you keep using the phone. CLI / MCP / HTTP, via Shizuku or root. 安卓手机上的后台副屏：手机、电脑或云端的 AI agent 都能用它操作应用。
